Our partner is looking for a Trenches / Web3 Frontend Developer based in Saudi Arabia. This is a high-ownership frontend engineering role focused on building the client experience for a fast-moving onchain trading terminal. You will own critical trading surfaces across both Solana and EVM, working directly on products used for real transactions and real money. The role combines advanced frontend engineering with deep Web3, trading, wallet, and real-time application expertise. You will take features from product idea through implementation, production release, measurement, and continuous improvement. You'll work in a small, highly autonomous team where technical judgment, speed, and product instincts matter. The environment is remote-first, AI-native, and designed for engineers who thrive with significant ownership and limited bureaucracy. Your work will directly influence trading performance, execution quality, user experience, and revenue-generating product surfaces. Accountabilities Own the frontend client experience for trenches trading, perpetuals, and prediction markets across Solana and EVM. Take end-to-end ownership of at least one revenue-generating product surface, from identifying opportunities and proposing solutions through development, production deployment, and optimization. Build and improve latency-sensitive trading experiences, including live data, execution, fill-quality UX, snipe controls, order flow, transaction states, and responsive interactions. Bring the trenches terminal to competitive parity or beyond with leading onchain trading products, focusing on the interactions that directly influence execution and fills. Unify Solana and EVM wallet, signing, approval, and transaction experiences into a coherent user interface while maintaining feature parity across supported platforms. Optimize browser and frontend performance using technologies and patterns such as WebSockets, RPC streams, optimistic UI, reconnection strategies, and backpressure management. Own measurable frontend performance outcomes, including p95 time-to-interactive and time-to-fill. Design and maintain trading interfaces covering charting, PnL, fills, transaction states, and onchain failure handling. Own production quality for the surfaces you deliver, reducing defect rates and preventing recurring incidents. Use strong product judgment to determine what should be built, particularly where latency, execution quality, and trader experience are critical. Work closely with frontend, UX, backend, and DevOps colleagues in a compact, cross-functional engineering environment. Use AI-native development practices to accelerate delivery while maintaining rigorous technical review and accountability for production quality. Requirements 3+ years of relevant frontend engineering experience, with demonstrated ownership of production-grade Web3 or onchain products. Proven experience shipping products involving real users and real money, such as perpetuals, decentralized exchanges, launchpads, prediction markets, or trading terminals. Hands-on production experience with both Solana and EVM ecosystems; experience with only one ecosystem is not sufficient. Genuine familiarity with onchain trading and its mechanics, including fills, slippage, priority fees, execution quality, and transaction behavior. Strong frontend engineering expertise in real-time and latency-sensitive applications, including WebSockets, RPC streams, optimistic interfaces, reconnection, and backpressure. Experience building sophisticated trading interfaces involving charting, order flow, PnL, fills, transaction states, and onchain error handling. Experience with Solana wallet adapters and embedded wallet solutions such as Privy or comparable technologies. Ability to understand and diagnose frontend performance issues at a systems level rather than relying solely on established recipes or patterns. Demonstrated product ownership and initiative, including proposing, building, and launching features without requiring detailed specifications or assigned tickets. Experience with mobile or cross-platform delivery is valuable, particularly maintaining feature parity across web and mobile applications. Strong understanding of modern frontend development practices and the ability to deliver reliable production software in a fast-paced environment. Demonstrated ability to use AI tools as a genuine part of the engineering workflow, including knowing what to delegate to AI and how to review and validate its output. Strong self-management, communication, prioritization, and problem-solving skills. Comfortable working remotely with reasonable overlap across global time zones. Passion for crypto, Web3, trading products, and building practical experiences for active users is strongly valued. Benefits Fully remote, remote-first working environment. Individual-contributor role with significant autonomy, ownership, and direct exposure to product decisions. Opportunity to work on high-impact Web3 products involving real-time trading and onchain transactions. Unlimited paid time off through a flexible paid-time-off program. Employee stock option program. Zero trading fees through the platform's application. Four months of extended family leave for birthing, non-birthing, and adopting parents. Premium health, dental, and life insurance in applicable countries. Paid volunteering days. Opportunity for rapid professional growth in a fast-moving crypto and technology environment. Close collaboration with a small, highly technical team and direct access to senior product and engineering leadership. linkedin_detail_4478700131.description: JOIN THE PEOPLE POWERING KODIAK Kodiak understands that our most valuable resource is our employees, and in order to provide industry-leading service and runtime, you must attract and retain premier talent. To accomplish this, Kodiak focuses on providing internal professional development and training, as well as the best benefits package in the industry. Summary The EH&S Vice President is responsible for the strategic development and implementation of EH&S programs and policies to ensure regulatory compliance, promote workplace safety, and minimize environmental impact. Key duties include fostering a strong EH&S culture, leading EH&S personnel, managing risk, overseeing incident investigations, coordinating with regulatory agencies, and analyzing EH&S performance to achieve business goals. The leader in this role must provide customer EH&S interface, as well as provide regular summary updates to executive leadership and the board of directors. A high degree of initiative is required, as well as the ability to work effectively in a matrix organizational structure. This role reports directly to the COO but will report to the EVP, EH&S for initial period. Essential Responsibilities Leadership Champion a strong “safety-first” mindset across the organization via training, communications, engagement, and visible leadership. Develop and mentor a team of high performance EH&S professionals across the organization. Demonstrate cross-functional collaboration to integrate EH&S considerations into all aspects of the business. Attend Customer EH&S functions and represent EH&S on a company wide basis. Demonstrate visible leadership by being present in the field and routinely conducting leader site visits. Risk Management Identify, assess, and mitigate risks related to occupational health and safety, and environmental hazards. Develop strategies and programs to adequately manage business EH&S risks. Compliance Ensure compliance with all applicable EH&S regulations, such as OSHA and EPA, and serve as the primary company liaison with the regulatory agencies. Contractor Safety Management Oversee Contractor Safety Management program and ensure compliance with Kodiak’s requirements, as well as Customer requirements. Incident Management Provide senior oversight for incident reporting, root cause analysis, and learning from incidents to prevent recurrence. Incorporate a continuous improvement approach to deliver a generative EH&S culture. Lead Kodiak’s Corporate Crisis Management Team and coordinate/support hurricane response efforts. EH&S Performance Goals Utilize data analytics, performance metrics, and leading indicators to track EH&S performance, recognize data trends, identify areas for improvement, and demonstrate progress in achieving business goals. Develop data-based strategies for the annual EH&S Plan (“predict and prevent” model) that will deliver improved performance. EH&S Auditing Oversee EH&S audit program and assess audit results to address identified gaps. Audit subcontractors to provide assurance of compliance and risk management. Participate in internal audits, as well as external regulatory audits, representing EH&S leadership. Communicate EH&S audit results with executive leadership and develop action plans. EH&S Budget Develop an annual budget and effectively deliver the EH&S programs within budget. Education & Certifications A Bachelor’s degree in Occupational Health and Safety, Environmental Science, or a related field required. Preferred certifications include Certified Safety Professional (CSP), Certified Industrial Hygienist (CIH), or Certified Hazardous Materials Manager (CHMM). Work Experience Minimum of fifteen (15) years of relevant oil & gas experience required. Minimum of ten (10) years of experience leading EH&S teams to develop and implement company-wide programs. Demonstrated EH&S performance improvement in previous work roles a plus. Required Skills & Qualifications Significant management experience, including managing cross-functional teams and leading EH&S programs. Excellent understanding of OSHA regulations and safety principles, and how they relate to Company operations. Demonstrated working knowledge of environmental regulations as they pertain to company operations, including providing oversight for environmental spill cleanup. Experience in effectively managing EH&S aspects of M&A deals, as well as divestitures. Ability to think strategically and develop innovative solutions for complex EH&S challenges. Ability to develop an annual EH&S Plan, communicate the plan, and track to closure. Strong problem-solving and analytical skills to interpret data, conduct risk assessments, and drive continuous improvement. Ability to formulate safety benchmark calculations, develop data trends, and draw insights from the trends to deliver cultural change. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present effectively to various stakeholders. Effectively work in a diverse community and easily translate complex topics to all levels of the organization, including senior leadership. Professionally represent company with Customers to implement workplace safety requirements, share learnings, and best practices. Effectively lead a team and deliver through others, as well as act as mentor to EH&S personnel. Effectively develop “talking points” that reinforce health, safety, and environmental objectives for executive leadership. Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite. Read, write, and speak English fluently. Legally authorized to work in the job posting country. Must have a valid U.S. driver’s license. Physical Demands Must be able to lift up to 50 lbs. Must be able to work in extreme environmental conditions. Must be available and able to work at any time / be on call. Must be able to bend, climb, and walk on all types of surfaces. A minimum of 50% travel may be required. Kodiak Gas Services is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer: All qualified applicants wi

linkedin_detail_4477944958.description: About Velixus Labs Velixus Labs is building the next generation of AI, blockchain, and Web3 infrastructure. We help organizations leverage decentralized technologies to create more secure, transparent, and intelligent digital products. We're a team of builders who enjoy solving difficult technical problems and turning ambitious ideas into production systems used by real people. The Role We're looking for a Senior Blockchain Engineer to help architect and build the blockchain products that power our clients' and partners' ecosystems. You'll work closely with product leaders, designers, and engineers to develop smart contracts, decentralized applications, and blockchain infrastructure that are secure, scalable, and ready for production. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys writing code, making architectural decisions, and taking ownership of products from concept to deployment. What You'll Do Design and develop smart contracts and blockchain-based applications. Build backend services and integrations that interact with blockchain networks. Participate in architecture discussions and help shape technical direction. Review code, improve engineering standards, and contribute to security best practices. Work closely with product and design teams to turn ideas into working products. Identify performance, scalability, and reliability improvements across the stack. Mentor other engineers and contribute to a strong engineering culture. Stay current with developments across blockchain, Web3, and decentralized infrastructure. What We're Looking For Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience building production systems. Professional experience developing blockchain applications or smart contracts. Deep understanding of Ethereum, EVM-based networks, or similar blockchain ecosystems. Experience with Solidity and modern Web3 development tools. Ability to make sound technical decisions and work independently. A practical approach to building secure, maintainable software. Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset. Nice to Have Experience building DeFi, tokenization, wallet, NFT, or infrastructure products. Familiarity with Layer 2 networks or cross-chain technologies. Experience working in startups or fast-moving product teams. Contributions to open-source projects or active participation in the blockchain community. Why Join Velixus Labs Work on meaningful blockchain and AI projects with global clients. Join a team that values ownership, curiosity, and technical excellence. Flexible remote-first environment. Competitive compensation and performance incentives. Learning and development support for conferences, certifications, and training. Opportunity to help shape products and technical direction from an early stage. Compensation We believe exceptional engineers should be rewarded for the value they create. Annual base salary: $180,000 – $260,000 USD Compensation is determined based on experience, technical expertise, location, and overall impact. In addition to base salary, eligible employees may receive performance-based bonuses, equity participation, or token incentives where applicable. Exceptional candidates may be considered above the stated range. Benefits & Perks Remote-first flexibility and flexible working hours. Competitive compensation package. Annual learning and development budget. Company-provided equipment and home office support. Flexible paid time off policy. Career growth opportunities in a rapidly evolving industry. How to Apply Send your resume, GitHub profile (if available), and a brief summary of blockchain projects you've worked on to: careers@velixuslabs.com We're most interested in what you've built and the problems you've solved.

linkedin_detail_4478097190.description: Job Description Job Description Vice President, Restructuring Location: Dubai, United Arab Emirates About Jefferies Jefferies is a leading global, full-service investment banking and capital markets firm, delivering strategic advisory, financing and capital markets solutions to corporate, sponsor and institutional clients worldwide. Our Restructuring and Liability Management Advisory practice advises companies, shareholders, lenders, sovereign-related entities and other stakeholders on complex capital structure challenges, balance sheet optimisation, distressed situations, recapitalisations and strategic alternatives. As activity across the Middle East continues to evolve, we are looking to expand our Dubai-based team with the addition of an experienced Vice President. The Opportunity This is a unique opportunity to join a growing franchise and play a leading role in advising clients across the Middle East, North Africa and broader EMEA region on complex restructuring, liability management and special situations transactions. The successful candidate will work directly with senior bankers and clients, leading transaction execution while helping to develop and grow Jefferies' restructuring advisory presence across the region. Key Responsibilities Lead the execution of restructuring, refinancing, recapitalisation, liability management and distressed M&A mandates across the Middle East and broader EMEA region. Manage all aspects of transaction execution, including financial analysis, stakeholder coordination, due diligence and project management. Develop and review complex financial models, liquidity analyses, business plans, capital structure assessments and valuation materials. Prepare high-quality client presentations, strategic reviews, board materials and transaction documentation. Work closely with corporate clients, financial institutions, sovereign-related entities, private equity sponsors and creditor groups. Support Managing Directors in business development efforts, market coverage and origination activities. Identify and evaluate new restructuring and special situations opportunities across the region. Lead and mentor Analysts and Associates, ensuring high-quality work product and professional development. Coordinate effectively with legal advisers, accounting firms, lenders, investors and other external stakeholders throughout transaction processes. Requirements 6-10+ years of relevant experience within an investment bank, restructuring advisory practice, financial advisory firm or leading professional services organisation. Strong transaction experience across restructuring advisory, special situations, leveraged finance, debt advisory or corporate finance. Excellent financial modelling, valuation and analytical skills. Strong understanding of debt products, capital structures, credit markets and restructuring solutions. Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams and execute transactions in a fast-paced environment. Experience interacting with senior management teams, boards, lenders and investors. Exceptional presentation, communication and stakeholder management skills. Strong leadership capabilities with experience managing and developing junior team members. Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting or a related discipline. Influencing team members and leaders across the enterprise to own key safety initiatives that will reduce risk. Build continuity between business expectations and EHS initiatives, continually building partnerships. Ensuring all environmental, health, safety, and security regulatory requirements are met and in compliance with applicable laws and regulations. Utilizing metrics and innovative incentives and techniques to drive the correct safety behavior at all levels of the organization. About Quant Almost all the money in the economy is commercial bank money, and almost none of it moves on chain. Quant is a leading provider of programmable money infrastructure, and our technology changes that: it lets banks issue, move and settle tokenized deposits around the clock, automatically and securely, while staying connected to the systems they already run on. It is already deployed in regulated environments with central and commercial banks in the UK and around the world, including work on the digital pound and the digital euro. The Clearing House, whose networks clear and settle more than $2 trillion a day, has now selected Quant to power its On-Chain Money Initiative: a new interoperable payments network that will let financial institutions of all sizes clear and settle tokenized deposits, with connectivity to the RTP® and CHIPS® networks. Our technology provides the network's interoperability, orchestration and transaction-management layer, enabling payments that settle immediately and transactions that trigger automatically once agreed conditions are met. Through our Tokenized Deposits-as-a-Service solution, banks of any size can join without building new infrastructure themselves. The network is expected to become available to participating institutions in the first half of 2027, with use cases across corporate treasury, liquidity management, cross-border payments and digital asset settlement. linkedin_detail_4478335108.description: Job Description Who We Are At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me , Do the Right Thing , and Get Things Done . These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more. About The Opportunity You are the Relationship Monetizer for all VIP institutions. Your network is the pipeline. You originate, progress, and close partnerships with VIP institutional clients - banks, asset managers, hedge funds, family offices, quant funds, and sovereign wealth funds - that generate substantial, recurring revenues and validate OKX as a credible institutional counterparty globally. What You’ll Be Doing Tier 1 network ownership and expansion. You curate, expand, and monetize your personal network of C-suite relationships at the largest global financial institutions. Your network is the vertical’s primary competitive advantage. Revenue ownership and pipeline oversight. You carry the consolidated institutional revenue target across all segments. You own the number, the forecast, and pipeline health. Vertical strategy and segment prioritization. You determine how to balance long-cycle bank partnerships (6-12+ months, custom integration, marquee logos) with shorter-cycle fund and asset manager clients (3-6 months, more standardized product, revenue velocity). Tier 1 deal origination and closing (commercial structuring). You are the commercial architect on the biggest deals. You structure creative partnerships, negotiate terms, and close. You work alongside your Sr. Relationship Director who drives relationship-led selling and oversee the Sr. Institutional RM who executes commercially. Product need analysis and advocacy (ROI estimate of feature requests). Institutional clients surface product requirements that don’t exist yet — custom custody flows, new API capabilities, regulatory wrappers. You translate these into business cases with ROI estimates and advocate internally with product and engineering. Regulatory positioning and compliance reflection. Traditional institutions’ primary barrier is not capital efficiency — it’s regulatory confidence. You articulate OKX’s regulatory standing (MiCA licensing, banking partnerships, compliance infrastructure) to client compliance committees, boards, and risk teams. You make the case for why OKX is a defensible counterparty. External positioning and institutional marketing narrative. You own how OKX is perceived in the institutional market. You shape the narrative for OKX institutional and oversee the development of sales and marketing collateral (pitch decks, solution briefs, case studies, competitive positioning documents), shape press releases for institutional milestones, and develop thought leadership content that articulates OKX’s integration-first, relationship-led positioning. What We Look For In You 10+ years of Business Development experience Active institutional network. You have done business with C-suite decision-makers at banks, asset managers, and funds within the last 18 months. Personal deal closing experience. You have personally originated and closed institutional partnerships. Deep crypto product fluency. You can discuss custody models, trading infrastructure, FIX connectivity, settlement mechanics, and regulatory frameworks credibly without preparation. Investigates fires, determines cause & origin, and completes all reports as required. Educates the public regarding fire prevention and fire warden duties. linkedin_detail_4459957465.description: Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at circle.com. What You’ll Be Part Of Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder. What You’ll Be Responsible For Reporting to the Global Head of Capital Markets, you are a capital markets specialist to drive USDC adoption across the repo and swap dealer ecosystem. This role will focus on integrating USDC into secured financing, derivatives margining, and dealer balance-sheet workflows, working directly with primary dealers, swap dealers, clearinghouses, and market infrastructure providers. This is a hands-on role at the intersection of market structure, regulation, and product execution. What You'll Work On Dealer & Market Infrastructure Engagement: Leading technical engagement with swap dealers, primary dealers, FCMs, CCPs, custodians, and tri-party agents. Acting as a credible counterpart to dealer treasury and funding teams, and drive pilots from design through live execution in coordination with internal product and engineering teams. Regulatory & Risk Alignment Partnering with legal, compliance, and risk teams to ensure USDC integrations align with applicable derivatives and market regulations. Anticipating regulatory and risk concerns from counterparties and help structure use cases that are scalable and defensible. Internal Leadership & Expertise Serving as the internal expert on repo markets, dealer balance sheets, and derivatives market structure. Advising senior leadership on where USDC can deliver meaningful capital, liquidity, and operational benefits. Core Requirements What you’ll bring to Circle: 12+ years of extensive experience in traditional capital markets, with direct exposure to repo markets, swap dealers, derivatives margining, or collateral management. Experience with primary dealers, swap dealers, FCMs, CCPs, custodians, or major market infrastructure providers. Strong understanding of dealer funding models, balance-sheet constraints, and regulatory capital considerations. Familiarity with margin frameworks, netting, segregation, rehypothecation, and liquidity requirements will be essential for success in this role. Proven capability in negotiating and securing high-impact strategic deals at a C-level audience level, exhibiting strong persuasive and communication skills. Familiarity with generative AI models (ChatGPT, Gemini, etc.) and prompt development Preferred Requirements Previous experience with cryptocurrency industries, including key players, products, and trends. Experience/familiarity with Slack, Apple MacOS and GSuite. Additional Information This position is eligible for day-one PERM sponsorship for qualified candidates Circle is on a mission to create an inclusive financial future, with transparency at our core. We consider a wide variety of elements when crafting our compensation ranges and total compensation packages. Starting pay is determined by various factors, including but not limited to: relevant experience, skill set, qualifications, and other business and organizational needs. Please note that compensation ranges may differ for candidates in other locations. Base Pay Range: $212,500 - $272,500 We are an equal opportunity employer . We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status, or any other protected status required by the laws in the locations where we hire. Additionally, Circle participates in the E-Verify Program in certain locations, as required by law. Should you require accommodations or assistance in our interview process because of a disability, please reach out to accommodations@circle.com for support. We respect your privacy and will connect with you separately from our interview process to accommodate your needs.

This role focuses on building secure, scalable blockchain solutions that integrate seamlessly with cloud-native microservices and traditional enterprise applications. You will work closely with solution architects, security engineers, DevOps teams, and product owners to develop smart contracts, blockchain APIs, digital wallet integrations, tokenization platforms, and secure transaction processing systems. The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise in blockchain protocols, smart contract development, distributed systems, and cloud infrastructure while maintaining strong software engineering fundamentals. Key Responsibilities Design and develop secure smart contracts for enterprise blockchain applications using Solidity or other smart contract languages. Build scalable backend services that interact with blockchain networks for transaction processing, asset management, and identity verification. Develop RESTful and GraphQL APIs to expose blockchain functionality to web and mobile applications. Design blockchain data models, token standards, and transaction workflows for high-volume enterprise systems. Integrate enterprise applications with Ethereum, Hyperledger Fabric, Polygon, Avalanche, or other blockchain platforms. Develop secure wallet integrations, digital signature workflows, and key management solutions. Implement blockchain event listeners, indexing services, and off-chain processing components. Build scalable microservices using .NET Core, Java, or Node.js that interact with blockchain networks. Optimize smart contracts for gas efficiency, scalability, and transaction throughput. Perform smart contract audits, security testing, and vulnerability assessments before production deployments. Collaborate with DevOps teams to deploy blockchain infrastructure across Azure or AWS cloud environments. Participate in architectural reviews, code reviews, technical design sessions, and production support activities. Troubleshoot complex blockchain network issues, transaction failures, synchronization problems, and production incidents Required Skills Six or more years of professional software development experience building enterprise-grade distributed applications. Three or more years of hands-on blockchain development experience delivering production blockchain solutions. Strong experience developing smart contracts using Solidity and Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM)-compatible networks. Hands-on experience with blockchain platforms such as Ethereum, Hyperledger Fabric, Polygon, Avalanche, Binance Smart Chain, or Quorum. Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript with Node.js or backend development using C#/.NET Core or Java. Experience building decentralized applications (dApps) with React, Angular, or Vue.js. Strong understanding of blockchain architecture, consensus algorithms, cryptographic hashing, digital signatures, Merkle trees, and distributed ledger concepts. Experience implementing ERC-20, ERC-721, ERC-1155, or custom token standards. Experience integrating wallets such as MetaMask, WalletConnect, Coinbase Wallet, or enterprise custody platforms. Strong experience with REST APIs, GraphQL APIs, WebSockets, and blockchain RPC interfaces. Experience working with SQL and NoSQL databases including PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, or Redis. Hands-on experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated deployments, and release management. Experience deploying applications on Azure or AWS cloud platforms. Strong debugging, performance optimization, and troubleshooting skills in production environments. Experience working within Agile Scrum development teams. Preferred Qualifications Experience designing enterprise blockchain solutions for financial services, healthcare, insurance, or supply chain industries. Hands-on experience with Hyperledger Fabric chaincode development using Go or Java. Experience with Layer-2 scaling solutions including Polygon, Arbitrum, or Optimism. Familiarity with Zero-Knowledge Proofs (ZKP), Multi-Party Computation (MPC), or privacy-preserving blockchain technologies. Experience implementing decentralized identity (DID) and Verifiable Credentials (VC). Knowledge of blockchain security standards, smart contract auditing tools, and common vulnerabilities such as reentrancy, overflow, front-running, and flash loan attacks. Experience using Hardhat, Foundry, Truffle, Ganache, Brownie, or Remix IDE. Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, and Infrastructure as Code. Experience integrating blockchain applications with enterprise identity providers including Azure Active Directory or OAuth. Blockchain certifications or contributions to open-source blockchain projects are highly desirable. linkedin_detail_4480311984.description: About D3 D3 is building the world’s first purpose-built blockchain for DomainFi —bringing domain tokenization and DeFi primitives to a massive, rapidly growing $350B+ real-world asset class . We’re revolutionizing how existing and future domain names are owned, traded, and leveraged in the digital economy. Our elite team is stacked with industry veterans who have spent the last three decades shaping the internet , from pioneering domain name monetization to architecting key internet protocols to launching and running major TLDs like .xyz, .inc, .tv, and .link . With a proven track record of innovation and success, we’re now redefining what’s possible in the domain space. We recently closed a $25M Series A led by Paradigm - one of the best investors in the industry. This will help fuel our mission to bring domains fully on-chain and unlock new financial possibilities for one of the internet’s most valuable asset classes. We’re based in Los Angeles, with team members all over the world. We’re looking for driven, talented builders to help build a trillion-dollar DomainFi economy. Join us! Job Overview We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Solana Blockchain Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will work on the design and implementation of our DOMA Protocol connecting traditional DNS and web3 naming technologies to create a unified naming system compatible across the Internet and all blockchains. You will play a critical role in developing and maintaining our core platform APIs and smart contracts integration with the Solana blockchain. Familiarity with Solana smart contracts and blockchain standards such as SPL Token, Metaplex, and Token-2022 is essential. Key Responsibilities Collaborate with the product team to understand requirements and translate them into technical specifications and features. Lead the research, design, implementation, deployment and monitoring of the DOMA Protocol that enables tokenization of domains as Real World Assets (RWAs) onto the Solana blockchain. Research, implement and maintain Solana programs to enable “DomainFi” applications across the Solana ecosystem. This includes tokenization, name resolution, secondary trading, and lending/borrowing. Implement backend services to interface with the Solana blockchain and traditional DNS Registry/Registrar infrastructure. Ensure the scalability, performance, and security of the protocol and application. Ensure code quality through code reviews, testing, and debugging. Maintain and optimize the performance of existing codebase and address any bugs or issues that arise. Stay up-to-date with the latest technologies, frameworks, and best practices in web development, blockchain, and smart contract development. Qualifications Strong passion for Blockchain technologies and protocols. Extensive knowledge and experience in Solana blockchain including smart contract development and deployment, blockchain bridges, oracles, indexers, decentralized finance, and NFT marketplaces. Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field. Relevant certifications and additional coursework are a plus. Minimum 5 years of professional experience in backend development using Node.js and MySQL/Postgres. Minimum 3 years experience in blockchain development using Solidity/Rust, with strong understanding of distributed systems, consensus algorithms and storage subsystems. Familiarity with Git version control and Agile methodologies for collaborative development. Strong problem-solving skills, adaptability, and a self-motivated attitude, with a willingness to learn new technologies in a fast-paced startup environment. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively both independently and within cross-functional teams to achieve business goals. PLUSES: DevOps experience with Kubernetes, Digital Ocean, Google Cloud, AWS, and Linux environments. Familiarity with NestJS and GraphQL. Have prior experience maintaining or creating blockchain oracles. Why D3, Why Now? Ground-Floor Growth, Learning, and Impact : D3 is your chance to dive headfirst into an ultra-early-stage company where every move you make truly matters. You’ll have the opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and shape the foundation of something groundbreaking. Almost everything we’re building today at D3 is “zero-to-one,” meaning you’ll be among the first to craft, refine, and launch key initiatives that define our future success. Strong, Proven Leadership : At D3, you’ll work alongside industry visionaries who have been there, done that, and are ready to do it again—only bigger. Our leadership team brings veteran industry experience, sharp insights, and a relentless drive to do big things across every function at D3. You’ll gain invaluable mentorship, develop a high-impact mindset, and be challenged to grow in ways you never imagined. Unique Market Positioning – We’re pioneering at the intersection of internet infrastructure, real-world assets, and blockchain communities, creating solutions that redefine what’s possible in Web3. If you want to push boundaries, solve complex problems, and be part of a team that’s shaping the future of the Internet, D3 is the place to do it.

linkedin_detail_4480360032.description: Remote (U.S.) — Full Time The Cari Network is building a blockchain-based payment system powering real-time, 24/7 movement of digital money across the traditional finance and digital asset ecosystems. A pre-launch startup, we're creating an entirely new category of financial infrastructure that brings cash on chain through tokenization while powering the full spectrum of payments for our network—banks, digital asset exchanges, and, most importantly, the customers they serve. About The Role You'll work within the systems that take a payment instruction and turn it into an immutable, on-chain record—implementing features and extensions within an established transaction pipeline architecture, alongside senior engineers who own its design. That means building out pieces of the integration layer between our backend services and our institutional custody platform, and contributing to transaction integrity from calldata construction through on-chain finality on our private ZKsync-based L2. You'll also work directly in our smart contract suite, extending existing contracts under established upgrade-safety and role-governance patterns, and building the audit trail and compliance evidence that regulated bank partners require. What You'll Do Implement components of the transaction lifecycle: calldata construction, custody platform signing requests, nonce handling, L2 submission, and finality confirmation, working within the pipeline architecture senior engineers on the team have designed Build features within the signing pipeline—new submission paths, throughput handling against custody platform rate limits, async transaction submission logic—under existing architectural patterns Implement payment integrity controls: commitment hash verification at pipeline handoff points and co-signer policy evaluation logic Extend our Solidity smart contracts, following established upgrade-safety, storage-layout, and role-governance conventions Contribute to the custody platform authorization policy integration and co-signer agent for custodian-owned transaction authorization Build structured audit trail logging from transaction origination through on-chain execution, satisfying evidentiary requirements for bank partners under regulatory oversight Contribute to the async transaction queue supporting tiered SLAs and per-bank throughput quotas Write high-coverage tests across backend services and smart contracts, maintaining our coverage threshold Participate in on-call, working through known issue patterns independently and escalating novel failure modes to senior engineers Qualifications 3–5 years of backend software engineering experience, with 1–2 years working directly on EVM-compatible blockchain systems Solid proficiency in TypeScript; familiarity with Effect (effect.ts) or a comparable functional effect system is a plus Working familiarity with EVM transaction mechanics: ABI encoding, nonce management, gas estimation, revert handling, and event decoding Some production experience with Solidity smart contract development, including exposure to upgradeable proxy patterns (UUPS) and OpenZeppelin contract libraries Exposure to institutional custody or key management APIs is a strong plus, though not required Understanding of idempotency, at-least-once delivery, and crash recovery concepts in async systems Comfortable asking for help extending existing patterns while building toward independent ownership of larger features Nice to Haves Experience with ZKsync or ZK Stack-based chains—particularly developer-facing constraints like calldata handling, system contract interactions, and AA transaction formats Familiarity with Kafka or message-queue-backed async pipelines Prior work in fintech, payments, or any regulated financial infrastructure environment Foundry proficiency (forge test, forge fmt) What We Offer Competitive compensation Remote-first work environment Opportunity to shape a market-defining protocol with an experienced founding team Meaningful influence over product design at the earliest stage Interested in this role? Send us your resume. ‹ Senior Data Engineer Senior Blockchain Engineer ›

linkedin_detail_4480519077.description: Job Description KAR OG Alan Sasan DMCC is seeking an experienced Senior Geologist to join its Exploration & Development Department. Position Title: Senior Geologist Department: Exploration & Development Department Reports To: Exploration & Development Manager Work Location: Erbil, with travel to field locations as required Working Days: Sunday–Thursday Working Hours: 8:30 AM–4:30 PM Employment Type: Full-time Position Summary The Senior Geologist is responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing geological activities related to exploration, appraisal, and field development. The role involves seismic interpretation, geological interpretation and static modelling, prospect maturation, well location selection, exploration and appraisal well planning, preparation of technical scopes of work, and evaluation of geological and drilling-related tenders. The position also oversees wellsite geology, mud logging, coring operations, geological sample management, and laboratory analysis. The Senior Geologist integrates geological, geophysical, petrophysical, and well data to support drilling decisions, reservoir characterization, hydrocarbon resource evaluation, and field development planning. Key Responsibilities Seismic Interpretation Interpret 2D and 3D seismic data to define structural and stratigraphic frameworks. Correlate seismic interpretations with well data, geological observations, and static reservoir models. Identify drilling targets, structural closures, faults, and geological risks. Support prospect evaluation, well location selection, and exploration/appraisal drilling decisions. Geological Interpretation and Static Modelling Develop, maintain, and update geological and structural models by integrating seismic, well, petrophysical, core, and other subsurface data. Support reservoir characterization, hydrocarbon volumetric estimation (STOIIP/GIIP), and uncertainty assessment. Integrate geological interpretations into static reservoir models and exploration prospect evaluations. Build, review, and quality-control 3D static geological models using Petrel or equivalent software. Exploration and Appraisal Well Planning Prepare geological programmes and Scopes of Work (SOWs) for exploration and appraisal wells. Define geological objectives, target formations, expected lithology, formation tops, coring intervals, sampling requirements, and geological data acquisition programmes. Develop pre-drill geological prognoses and geological risk assessments. Participate in multidisciplinary well planning, drilling engineering reviews, and appraisal well design. Develop coring, sampling, and geological data acquisition strategies. Identify geological and operational risks and recommend mitigation measures. Optimize geological programmes to maximize data quality while minimizing operational costs and rig time. Tender Preparation and Technical Evaluation Prepare technical specifications, SOWs, tender documents, and technical evaluation criteria for geological services. Evaluate contractors’ technical procedures, personnel qualifications, equipment specifications, and quality assurance documentation. Participate in contractor performance evaluations and acceptance of project deliverables. Wellsite Geological Supervision Review daily geological reports and provide recommendations to the drilling team. Coordinate geological decision-making during drilling operations. Support casing point selection, coring, logging, and total depth (TD) decisions based on geological observations. Coordinate with drilling, petrophysics, reservoir engineering, and geophysics teams to optimize well objectives. Mud Logging Supervision Review and approve daily mud logging reports and contractor deliverables. Monitor gas trends, drilling parameters, and hydrocarbon shows to support geological interpretation. Ensure mud logging operations comply with company standards, contractual requirements, and industry best practices. Conduct technical audits and performance reviews of mud logging contractors. Coring Operations Supervise coring operations and ensure proper core orientation, preservation, photography, slabbing, transportation, and storage in accordance with company procedures. Geological Sample Management Ensure proper preservation, cataloguing, storage, and transportation of drill cuttings, conventional cores, sidewall cores, and hydrocarbon samples. Maintain geological sample inventories and chain-of-custody records. Ensure compliance with company sample management standards and procedures. Cuttings and Core Analysis Plan, supervise, and interpret Routine Core Analysis (RCAL) and Special Core Analysis (SCAL) programmes. Evaluate laboratory measurements, including porosity, permeability, grain density, fluid saturation, capillary pressure, relative permeability, wettability, and other relevant parameters. Interpret cuttings and core analysis results to support geological evaluation and reservoir characterization. Geological Reporting Prepare geological prognoses, daily geological reports, formation top reports, coring reports, end-of-well reports, and post-drill geological evaluations. Present geological findings, interpretations, and recommendations to management and multidisciplinary technical teams.

Kalyon Holding: Empowering Turkey’s Future Prioritizing contributions to people, society, and the environment, Kalyon Holding continues its journey in harmony with Turkey’s development goals, guided by long-term principles. Kalyon Holding has a strong presence not only in the economic sphere but also in social value initiatives. It has made lasting contributions to society in the fields of education, environment, and arts and culture. It established Erdem College in 1998, Hasan Kalyoncu University in 2008, and in 2020, launched Kalyon Kültür at Taş Konak in Şişli to support cultural production. With a sustainability-driven approach, Kalyon Holding undertakes projects that focus on the environment, people, technology, and qualified human capital, aiming to contribute to the country’s future. As an extension of this vision, the Kalyon Foundation was established to preserve and pass on Turkey’s historical, cultural, and environmental heritage through numerous projects carried out in collaboration with public institutions and civil society.

You play a key role in minimizing downtime by responding to operational needs, adhering to strict HSE standards, and maintaining the continuous performance of critical plant equipment. How You’ll Make An Impact Monitor and control gas turbine generators, auxiliary systems, and plant equipment through DCS to ensure safe, reliable, and efficient operations. Respond to alarms, investigate system abnormalities, and take corrective or emergency actions to maintain operational continuity. Conduct routine equipment inspections, identify faults or abnormalities, and support troubleshooting and maintenance activities. Safely isolate equipment and implement Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) procedures while verifying plant readiness following maintenance work. Maintain full compliance with HSE standards and environmental regulations through safety inspections, hazard identification, incident reporting, and participation in safety programs. What You Bring Technical Diploma or bachelor’s degree in mechanical, Electrical, Control & Instrumentation Engineering, with 3-5 years of experience in power plant operations, preferably within gas turbine or combined cycle power plants. DCS Operator Certification and a recognized Health & Safety certification such as OSHA, NEBOSH, or equivalent. Strong expertise in Distributed Control Systems (DCS), gas turbine technology, auxiliary equipment, and Balance of Plant (BOP) systems. Proven knowledge of safety procedures including Lockout/Tagout (LOTO), hazard identification, risk assessment, and emergency response protocols. Excellent troubleshooting, root cause analysis, technical documentation, shift reporting, communication, and teamwork skills. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. The opportunity You will be a part of the Digital Asset Research Center, an innovative and collaborative group of software developers, financial auditors and technology consultants who are dedicated to developing the deep technical understanding, methodology and tools required to deliver a variety of Assurance services to companies that hold and transact in digital assets. You will have the opportunity to research the latest public blockchains, smart contracts and digital assets, as well as serve the clients that drive this exciting and disruptive industry forward. The EY organization serves a wide range of companies in the digital asset ecosystem, such as well-known global digital asset exchanges, custodians, miners/validators, payment providers, investment managers and broker-dealers. To provide Assurance services including financial audits, audit-readiness, forensic investigations and related due diligence, we must have a technical understanding of the wide variety of public blockchains, smart contracts and the digital assets native to these platforms, along with the relevant risks and controls involved. We also must develop tools and methodology to assess our clients’ activities in this sector. The Digital Asset Research Center makes this possible. We are a small, focused team that is rapidly growing. You will be exposed to and involved with all levels of business management and have numerous opportunities for personal growth and career development. While the Digital Asset Research Center primarily focuses on US clients, you will be collaborating with similar teams in other regions in Europe, India, Asia-Pacific and the Americas. In addition, we’re looking for people who recognize the importance of new technologies and are willing to learn and be curious. If you’re passionate about problem-solving and finding innovative solutions to complex issues, this role is for you. We strive to foster a caring, high-performance growth culture that will deliver consistent, sustainable profitable growth and accelerate our performance – a culture where accountability is clear and aligned, and where we reward business outcomes and impact. That culture guides everything we do, including how we partner with our customers and suppliers, how we attract and retain top talent, and how we create and deliver value to our stakeholders. In 2025, Sealed Air generated $5.4 billion in sales and has approximately 16,100 employees who serve customers in 119 countries/territories. To learn more, visit www.sealedair.com. What will you do as an EHS NAM Director at Sealed Air? The North America Director, Environment, Health, Safety & Sustainability (EHS&S) will lead the EHS&S strategy and execution across more than 48 manufacturing facilities throughout North America. This role will partner closely with Operations, Engineering, Maintenance, Human Resources, and senior leadership to strengthen EHS&S performance, improve consistency across the manufacturing network, and ensure that critical operational risks are effectively identified, prioritized, and controlled. The Director will lead through experienced Regional EHS Managers and site-level EHS professionals, balancing strategic leadership with strong operational and technical credibility. The role requires significant visibility across manufacturing locations and approximately 60% travel throughout North America. Why do we need you? Lead the development and execution of the North America EHS&S strategy across a complex, multi-site manufacturing network. Strengthen and standardize EHS management systems, policies, governance, audit processes, corrective-action systems, and regional deployment of global EHS standards. Lead the identification and reduction of critical manufacturing risks, including machine safety, guarding, hazardous-energy control / LOTO, electrical safety, contractor safety, serious-injury and fatality risks, and Management of Change. Partner with Operations, Engineering, and Maintenance leaders to integrate EHS requirements into plant operations, new equipment, capital projects, maintenance strategies, and operational decision-making. Lead and influence capital planning and EHS investment prioritization, including development of risk-based business cases for significant and multimillion-dollar projects. Drive environmental compliance and sustainability performance across the region, including regulatory compliance, waste, emissions, water, environmental management systems, and broader sustainability initiatives. Establish and monitor meaningful EHS metrics, KPIs, leading indicators, audit findings, incident trends, and corrective actions to identify systemic risks and improve organizational performance. Lead, coach, and develop Regional EHS Managers and site-level EHS teams while creating accountability and consistency across locations with different levels of maturity. Influence Plant Managers, Operations leaders, Engineering, HR, and senior executives without always relying on direct authority. Lead significant incident investigations, root-cause analysis, CAPA, and systemic risk-reduction initiatives. Support EHS integration for acquisitions, organizational changes, new operations, and major manufacturing projects. Build a strong EHS culture where Operations owns risk and EHS serves as a strategic business partner rather than a stand-alone compliance function. What do you need to succeed? Significant progressive EHS leadership experience within manufacturing environments. Strong experience leading EHS across multiple manufacturing facilities, preferably at regional or North America scale. Demonstrated technical depth in machine safety, guarding, LOTO / hazardous energy, equipment risk, electrical safety, operational risk, and Management of Change. Demonstrated experience influencing or managing significant capital investments and CAPEX prioritization, including development of business cases and risk-based investment decisions. Strong knowledge of U.S. EHS regulatory requirements, including OSHA and EPA requirements, with additional familiarity with applicable DOT and NFPA standards. Strong environmental-management experience and demonstrated exposure to sustainability initiatives. Experience implementing and governing enterprise EHS management systems, audits, standards, corrective-action processes, and performance metrics. Demonstrated ability to lead experienced EHS professionals and influence senior Operations and Plant leaders with strong and diverse leadership styles. Strong change-management capability, including experience driving adoption of new systems, standards, and ways of working across multiple sites. Strong executive communication skills and the ability to translate technical EHS risk into operational, financial, and business implications. Data-driven decision-making capability while maintaining the judgment and flexibility required to operate effectively in complex manufacturing environments where complete data may not always be available. Ability to travel approximately 60% throughout North America. Bachelor’s degree in Environmental Health & Safety, Engineering, Environmental Science, Occupational Safety, Industrial Hygiene, or a related technical discipline. Advanced degree and relevant professional certifications are preferred. Compensation $175,000-$185,000 USD/annually The range disclosed complies with applicable state and local pay transparency laws. Offers within this range will be determined by considering relevant factors including education, experience, and internal alignment Requisition id: 55477 Relocation: Yes Sealed Air is commit

For almost 100 years, Saur has become a pure player in water and essential services. We provide comprehensive solutions for drinking water supply, wastewater treatment and distribution, and smart water management. The Group works towards a clear and relevant objective: to be an advocate of water in order to protect one of our planet's most precious resources. An aspiration that lives on through our 13,000 employees in 20 countries. Do you want to work with a company that changes lives all over the world? Join our team #MissionWater. Job Summary The Works Operator is responsible for the independent execution of installation, maintenance, and repair works on drinking water and wastewater pipelines. The role involves preparing and securing the worksite, ensuring compliance with health, safety, and quality standards, and providing support for emergency interventions on the water network when required. This may include carrying out minor civil engineering tasks Your Main Responsabilities L’Agent Travaux Canalisateur intervient sur les réseaux d’eau potable (AEP) et d’assainissement (EU/EP). Il assure la pose, l’entretien, la réparation et le renouvellement des canalisations permettant le transport et la distribution des fluides. Il réalise des travaux de terrassement, de pose et de raccordement, tout en garantissant la conformité des installations aux normes en vigueur. Il travaille sous la responsabilité d’un référent, d’un chef d’équipe ou d’un chef de chantier. Missions principales Travaux de chantier Réaliser les travaux de terrassement (ouverture de tranchées, blindage). Effectuer le remblaiement et le compactage des tranchées. Poser des canalisations AEP et assainissement (PVC, PEHD, fonte). Installer les équipements de réseau (vannes, regards, branchements, poteaux incendie, etc.). Réaliser les branchements particuliers et les prises en charge sur réseaux existants. Participer à la détection de réseaux et au traçage avant travaux. Réalisation technique Assurer la bonne mise en œuvre des matériaux et pièces de canalisation. Appliquer les règles de l’art, les DTU et les normes en vigueur. Réaliser des essais de pression et tests d’étanchéité. Effectuer des contrôles qualité (analyses d’eau, désinfection des réseaux AEP). Réaliser des petits travaux de maçonnerie (regards, scellements). Assurer le nettoyage et la remise en état des chantiers. Organisation et logistique Anticiper les besoins en matériel et approvisionnements. Vérifier l’état du matériel et signaler les anomalies. Participer à la gestion et à l’entretien des outils et engins. Your Profile Profil recherché Compétences techniques Expérience significative sur chantier TP, idéalement en réseaux humides. Maîtrise des techniques de pose de canalisations AEP et EU. Capacité à lire et interpréter des plans et des profils en long. Connaissance des matériaux (PVC, PEHD, fonte) et accessoires de réseaux. Notions en génie civil et en hydraulique. Connaissance des règles de sécurité liées aux travaux publics (tranchées, réseaux, circulation). Capacité à travailler en équipe et en autonomie. Permis et habilitations Permis B et PL obligatoire. CACES R482 Catégorie A (engins de chantier) ou CACES R482 Catégorie B1 AIPR (Autorisation d’Intervention à Proximité des Réseaux) souhaitée. Habilitations complémentaires appréciées (H0B0, travail en espaces confinés, SST). Savoir être Rigueur et respect des consignes. Sens de l’organisation et anticipation. Esprit d’équipe et solidarité. Autonomie et prise d’initiative. Bon relationnel (collègues, hiérarchie, usagers). Ponctualité et assiduité. Engagement dans le respect des règles Hygiène, Sécurité, Qualité et Environnement (HSQE). Conditions d’exercice Travail en extérieur, en toutes conditions climatiques. Activité physique (port de charges, travail en tranchée). Déplacements fréquents selon les chantiers. Travail possible en horaires décalés ou en astreinte (selon organisation). Respect strict des consignes de sécurité (EPI obligatoires). Moyens mis à disposition Véhicules et engins de chantier. Outillage spécifique aux travaux de canalisation. Équipements de protection individuelle (EPI). Matériel de détection et de contrôle (pression, qualité eau). Évolution possible Chef d’équipe canalisateur. Conducteur d’engins spécialisé. Formation académique / technique : Diplôme en travaux publics, pose de canalisations, ou domaine connexe. Expérience professionnelle pertinente : Expérience en pose de canalisations, génie civil ou travaux publics appréciée. Les certifications telles que l'AIPR (Autorisation d'Intervention à Proximité des Réseaux), les habilitations électriques et la manipulation de l'amiante seraient appréciées. Rémunération : 25 000 à 31 000€ brut annuel sur 13,3 mois. Our Commitment As a committed employer, the Saur Group promotes diversity and considers all applications equally based on skills. Saur also places a strong emphasis on ethics, with integrity and transparency at the core of all its activities. Join us and help create a work environment where ethical principles guide every decision and action.

linkedin_detail_4477707395.description: Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at circle.com. What You’ll Be Part Of Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder. What You’ll Be Responsible For Circle is looking for an experienced transactional attorney to join the Transactions team within Circle’s Legal department. This role will focus primarily on two connected areas: Corporate Development and Ventures, including mergers and acquisitions, strategic transactions, and venture investments; and Financial Partnerships, including agreements with banks and other financial institutions that support Circle’s reserve, treasury, and payments operations. As needs arise, the role may also support select commercial transactions involving Circle’s products and services for banks and other financial institutions. Under the direction of the Deputy Assistant General Counsel, Transactions, you will work as a senior individual contributor and trusted advisor to Circle’s Corporate Development and Ventures, Treasury, and Financial Partnerships teams, and will partner with Business Development, Product, and other teams on select matters as needed. You will independently lead transactions from inception through negotiation, signing, closing, and, where relevant, implementation or integration. This role requires rigorous legal execution, practical business judgment, and a solutions-oriented approach in a fast-moving digital asset and payments environment. What You'll Work On Supporting mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, asset purchases, and other strategic transactions, including structuring, conducting due diligence, drafting definitive agreements, and coordinating signing, closing, and integration matters. Advising on joint ventures, minority and venture investments, strategic partnerships with an equity component, and other non-ordinary-course transactions, including term sheets, investment agreements, side letters, and ancillary agreements. Structuring, drafting, and negotiating agreements with banks and financial institutions supporting Circle’s reserve, treasury, and payments operations, including deposit, custody and safeguarding, account control, and cash management arrangements. Serving as a trusted partner to Circle’s Corporate Development and Ventures, Treasury, and Financial Partnerships teams, leading transactions that involve Legal, Regulatory, Risk, Compliance, Tax, Corporate Governance, Product, and other stakeholders, and coordinating with outside counsel where appropriate. As needs arise, supporting select commercial transactions in which Circle provides products, services, or technology to banks and other financial institutions, partnering with Business Development, Product, and Legal subject matter experts to translate business objectives into practical contractual terms. Developing and expanding transaction templates, playbooks, diligence tools, processes, and metrics that increase speed, consistency, and effectiveness across recurring transaction types. Helping design and lead the adoption of AI-enabled workflows across the Transactions team, rethinking how transactional legal work is structured and delivered, and using AI and other technology to improve diligence, contract review, issues lists, drafting, deal tracking, and other recurring workflows. Experimenting with new approaches, developing scalable processes and playbooks, and taking responsibility for reviewing and validating AI-assisted work product for accuracy, confidentiality, privilege, and risk. How This Role Uses AI This role will use AI as a core part of day-to-day transactional work and will help shape how the Transactions team operates in an AI-enabled environment. We are looking for someone who is interested not only in using new tools, but also in rethinking how legal work gets done—identifying which parts of the transactional process can be redesigned, streamlined, or automated while preserving high standards of legal judgment and client service. In practice, that means using AI tools to accelerate due diligence, review counterparty drafts against Circle’s playbooks and prior positions, prepare first drafts of issues lists, term sheets, and ancillary documents, and keep deal trackers and precedent current. The role will also identify recurring workflows where AI can improve speed and consistency, design and test new approaches, build and refine prompts, templates, and playbooks for AI-enabled work, and help other attorneys, interns, and business partners adopt effective practices. The attorney remains fully responsible for the work. They will review and validate AI-assisted outputs for accuracy and legal judgment, protect privilege, confidentiality, and material non-public information, and follow Circle’s AI, security, and data policies. We are looking for someone who is curious, experimental, and excited to help rethink how a modern transactions practice operates, while using AI to augment—not replace—independent legal judgment. Conduct security briefings, shift handovers, operational tasking and post checks, and ensure supervisors, guards, access controllers, CCTV operators and other security personnel understand their responsibilities and current threat posture. Ensure Asset Protection operations comply with PPCL policies, approved security plans, relevant contractual requirements and applicable Kurdistan Region / Iraqi legal and regulatory requirements. Incident, Crisis and Emergency Response: Act as a key Asset Protection operational focal point during security incidents and emergencies, supporting the Incident Management Team and coordinating security actions with Operations, HSE, Movcon, Government Forces, emergency responders and other stakeholders. Ensure immediate protective actions are implemented in accordance with approved emergency and evacuation arrangements, including shelter-in-place, relocation, controlled movement and evacuation support when directed. Ensure security incidents, near misses and breaches are reported, recorded, investigated and followed through to lessons learned and corrective action. Maintain readiness through exercises, drills, communications checks and periodic testing of emergency security procedures. Personnel and Contractor Management: Lead, coach and develop Asset Protection personnel; set clear performance expectations, conduct performance reviews and address capability, conduct or discipline issues appropriately. Ensure manpower plans, rosters and post allocations provide resilient security coverage while supporting cost-effective use of resources. Identify training needs and maintain competency standards for security personnel, including incident response, access control, CCTV, communications, emergency procedures and role-specific requirements. Maintain professional working relationships with private security providers, contractors and Government security forces while preserving clear PPCL oversight, accountability and assurance. Protective Security Operations: Oversee access and egress control, searching, visitor and contractor controls, CCTV monitoring, alarm response, patrols, perimeter security and protection of critical assets in accordance with approved procedures. Support secure movement arrangements and journey management requirements, including coordination of security escorts and emergency movement assets where applicable. Review security coverage and post requirements as operational activity, threat conditions and site layouts change, recommending proportionate adjustments to the Asset Protection Manager. Ensure faults, capability gaps and maintenance requirements affecting security systems are recorded, risk assessed, escalated and tracked to resolution. linkedin_detail_4472034804.description: We're partnering with Quant , a global leader in digital transformation and technology solutions, seeking a Protocol Engineering Lead to join their team. Protocol Engineering Lead Most people who write smart contracts never have to keep them running afterward. This job is the other half. The Clearing House has selected Quant to power its On-Chain Money Initiative, and the protocol work behind it, a permissioned EVM rollup on the OP Stack, is moving into production ahead of an expected launch in the first half of 2027. You would own the smart-contract release train, external audits on every release, and our diff against upstream Optimism: what we take, what we hold, and where we diverge on purpose. You would also explain the chain's unexpected behavior to people who are not protocol engineers. The pool of people who can do this is small. If you are near the edge of it, apply. You will need Deep Solidity and EVM experience, on contracts that held real value and went through external audit. Real understanding of rollup architecture, ideally the OP Stack. The mechanics rather than the vocabulary. To have maintained a fork of a large upstream codebase, and to know what that costs over time. To be able to explain chain behavior to reliability engineers, security engineers and eventually to a bank. Useful, not essential Permissioned or enterprise EVM deployments. Settlement, payments or tokenization rather than consumer applications. Public contributions. We will read them. There is more to this than we can put in an advertisement. If it sounds like your kind of problem, apply and we will tell you the rest on a call. About Quant Almost all the money in the economy is commercial bank money, and almost none of it moves on chain. Quant is a leading provider of programmable money infrastructure, and our technology changes that: it lets banks issue, move and settle tokenized deposits around the clock, automatically and securely, while staying connected to the systems they already run on. It is already deployed in regulated environments with central and commercial banks in the UK and around the world, including work on the digital pound and the digital euro. The Clearing House, whose networks clear and settle more than $2 trillion a day, has now selected Quant to power its On-Chain Money Initiative: a new interoperable payments network that will let financial institutions of all sizes clear and settle tokenized deposits, with connectivity to the RTP® and CHIPS® networks. Our technology provides the network's interoperability, orchestration and transaction-management layer, enabling payments that settle immediately and transactions that trigger automatically once agreed conditions are met. Through our Tokenized Deposits-as-a-Service solution, banks of any size can join without building new infrastructure themselves. The network is expected to become available to participating institutions in the first half of 2027, with use cases across corporate treasury, liquidity management, cross-border payments and digital asset settlement. We are building the New York team that will run it.

linkedin_detail_4482823658.description: Capital markets are undergoing a fundamental shift. Assets that live in fragmented systems and manual workflows are moving onto blockchains -systems designed to move and store value more transparently and efficiently. While this unlocks more open and programmable financial systems, it also introduces significant complexity. For most users, interacting with this new infrastructure is still too difficult. Fun builds the infrastructure that powers consumer-facing fintech applications - handling onboarding, account access, and money movement so users can interact with blockchain-based systems as seamlessly as they do with traditional finance. For fintech builders, Fun provides a best-in-class onboarding and deposit stack that drives conversion and unlocks user growth. We operate at the intersection of financial infrastructure, complex engineering, and product experience. Role Overview We're looking for a Protocol Engineer to join our core blockchain team and help build the foundation of Web3 payments infrastructure. This high-impact role offers the opportunity to work on challenging technical problems at the intersection of smart contracts, cross-chain protocols, and decentralized finance.
