linkedin_detail_4480647824.description: Our Client Our client is an established industrial manufacturing organization seeking an experienced Plant Manager to lead its PP woven bag manufacturing operations, ensuring production efficiency, product quality, operational reliability, and profitability. Role Overview Reporting to the General Manager, you will be responsible for the overall management and performance of the PP woven bag manufacturing facility, overseeing production, maintenance, quality, HSE, workforce management, budgets, and operational improvement. The role requires a hands-on manufacturing leader with strong technical expertise in polypropylene woven packaging, capable of optimizing plant performance, reducing production costs, improving equipment efficiency, and ensuring consistent product quality and timely delivery. Key Responsibilities Lead end-to-end plant operations, including PP tape extrusion, weaving, lamination, printing, cutting, stitching, and finished goods production, as applicable to the facility. Develop and execute production plans to achieve monthly output targets, optimize capacity utilization, and ensure timely delivery against customer requirements. Drive operational efficiency by improving Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE), machine availability, production yields, labor productivity, and manufacturing cost per kilogram. Oversee preventive and corrective maintenance programmes to minimize equipment breakdowns, production interruptions, and unplanned downtime. Establish and maintain robust quality control, HSE, and operational standards to minimize defects, material wastage, customer complaints, and workplace incidents. Manage plant budgets, raw material consumption, energy efficiency, supplier performance, manpower planning, and overall manufacturing profitability. Lead continuous improvement initiatives focused on process optimization, waste reduction, cost efficiency, workforce capability, and operational excellence. Must-Have Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical/Polymer Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical discipline is preferred. 10–15+ years of industrial manufacturing experience, preferably including at least 10 years in PP woven bags, polypropylene woven packaging, or closely related plastics manufacturing operations. Proven experience managing manufacturing plant operations with responsibility for production, maintenance, quality, safety, manpower, and operational budgets. Strong technical understanding of PP woven bag manufacturing processes, production machinery, raw materials, process parameters, and quality requirements. Demonstrated ability to improve key manufacturing KPIs, including production output, OEE, waste percentage, cost/kg, energy consumption (kWh/kg), machine availability, and labor productivity. Strong experience in production planning, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, cost optimization, supplier coordination, and continuous improvement methodologies. Proven leadership capability in managing multidisciplinary plant teams, maintaining safety standards, achieving production targets, and delivering measurable operational improvements. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted within 5–7 working days for a more detailed discussion about the role. Negotiations with the biggest car brands and companies in robotics and production automation on C-level in progress (some in final stage). The situation:Cars spend much of their time parked. Connected machines have processors, memory, and sometimes accelerators that may be underutilized.Our vision is to build a software layer that can aggregate this fragmented capacity into a secure, measurable, and monetizable network.Rather than building new data centers from scratch, we aim to use existing hardware wherever the economics, safety, connectivity, and technical constraints make it viable. Potential applications include: AI inference: Run suitable AI workloads on compatible edge devices. Token-based compute markets: Reward device owners or fleet operators for verified compute contributions. Blockchain infrastructure: Explore eligible node operations and selected blockchain workloads. Bitcoin mining: Evaluate whether compatible hardware and energy economics justify specialized mining deployments. New company tokens are possible and in negotiation. Fleet optimization: Help vehicle manufacturers, robot operators, and fleet owners monetize otherwise idle computing resources. The objective is to discover which workloads create sustainable revenue and build a platform capable of supporting millions of distributed devices. The CTO will own the technical vision and execution of the platform, from its initial architecture to a production-grade distributed computing network. This is a founding-level role for a technical leader who wants to build a new category of infrastructure at the intersection of edge computing, AI, robotics, connected vehicles, and digital assets. Responsibilities: Define the technical architecture, product roadmap, and infrastructure strategy. Build a distributed orchestration system for heterogeneous computing devices. Develop secure device agents, workload scheduling, monitoring, and resource accounting. Evaluate compute utilization, energy consumption, hardware constraints, and unit economics. Design mechanisms for transparent usage measurement and device-owner compensation. Evaluate blockchain and token-based incentive models where commercially justified. Establish partnerships with vehicle fleets, robotics operators, hardware providers, and compute customers. Recruit and lead the engineering organization. Work closely with the founding team on product strategy, fundraising, and commercial execution. We offer: A founding-level leadership position with substantial technical ownership. Meaningful equity participation, subject to negotiation and definitive agreements. The opportunity to shape the architecture, team, and strategic direction from the beginning. A technically ambitious project with applications across AI, robotics, connected vehicles, and distributed infrastructure. A compensation structure designed to evolve with funding, milestones, and company growth. The opportunity to build a new computing network rather than simply operate an existing one. The ideal candidate combines several of the following: Experience building distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, or edge computing platforms. Strong knowledge of Linux, containers, workload scheduling, and heterogeneous hardware. Experience with AI inference, GPUs, NPUs, or robotics systems. Security expertise involving untrusted devices and distributed execution. Familiarity with Web3 infrastructure, blockchain economics, or cryptographic verification. Startup experience, product judgment, and the ability to recruit a small, exceptional engineering team.

linkedin_detail_4483583330.description: Coin/token mining is super energy intensive - and it is in the hand of few and not decentralized! We democratize mining! Join as a founding CTO and lead an established team to super big!Patents are granted and rolled-out worldwide (continuation in progress). Tech team to implement tested feasibility and is ready to support the founding CTO. Negotiations with the biggest car brands and companies in robotics and production automation on C-level in progress (some in final stage). The situation:Cars spend much of their time parked. Robots spend periods waiting between tasks. Connected machines have processors, memory, and sometimes accelerators that may be underutilized. Our vision is to build a software layer that can aggregate this fragmented capacity into a secure, measurable, and monetizable network. Rather than building new data centers from scratch, we aim to use existing hardware wherever the economics, safety, connectivity, and technical constraints make it viable. Potential applications include: AI inference: Run suitable AI workloads on compatible edge devices. Token-based compute markets: Reward device owners or fleet operators for verified compute contributions. Blockchain infrastructure: Explore eligible node operations and selected blockchain workloads. Bitcoin mining: Evaluate whether compatible hardware and energy economics justify specialized mining deployments. New company tokens are possible and in negotiation. Fleet optimization: Help vehicle manufacturers, robot operators, and fleet owners monetize otherwise idle computing resources. The objective is to discover which workloads create sustainable revenue and build a platform capable of supporting millions of distributed devices. The CTO will own the technical vision and execution of the platform, from its initial architecture to a production-grade distributed computing network. This is a founding-level role for a technical leader who wants to build a new category of infrastructure at the intersection of edge computing, AI, robotics, connected vehicles, and digital assets. Responsibilities: Define the technical architecture, product roadmap, and infrastructure strategy. Build a distributed orchestration system for heterogeneous computing devices. Develop secure device agents, workload scheduling, monitoring, and resource accounting. Evaluate compute utilization, energy consumption, hardware constraints, and unit economics. Design mechanisms for transparent usage measurement and device-owner compensation. Evaluate blockchain and token-based incentive models where commercially justified. Establish partnerships with vehicle fleets, robotics operators, hardware providers, and compute customers. Recruit and lead the engineering organization. Work closely with the founding team on product strategy, fundraising, and commercial execution. We offer: A founding-level leadership position with substantial technical ownership. Meaningful equity participation, subject to negotiation and definitive agreements. The opportunity to shape the architecture, team, and strategic direction from the beginning. A technically ambitious project with applications across AI, robotics, connected vehicles, and distributed infrastructure. A compensation structure designed to evolve with funding, milestones, and company growth. The opportunity to build a new computing network rather than simply operate an existing one. The ideal candidate combines several of the following: Experience building distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, or edge computing platforms. Strong knowledge of Linux, containers, workload scheduling, and heterogeneous hardware. Experience with AI inference, GPUs, NPUs, or robotics systems. Security expertise involving untrusted devices and distributed execution. Familiarity with Web3 infrastructure, blockchain economics, or cryptographic verification. Startup experience, product judgment, and the ability to recruit a small, exceptional engineering team.

Arabic and/or Chinese language capability is an advantage. Technical Competencies: Good knowledge of international safety standards (ISO45001, OSHA). Strong incident investigation, risk assessment, audit and analytical problem‑solving skills. Excellent team supervision and cross‑party coordination capability. linkedin_detail_4484239642.description: About CoinList CoinList is building the distribution network for onchain capital markets. Through its Passage platform, CoinList provides the infrastructure that lets any wallet, app, or platform embed access to tokenized assets, from equities and funds to token sales and other real-world assets, through a single integration. With a network of over 12M investors and more than $1.2B in transactions, CoinList connects asset issuers with the platforms and investors who want access to them. Today, CoinList is scaling two core businesses: Passage (B2B Infrastructure) (passage.coinlist.co): "Onchain Infrastructure for Capital Markets." Passage allows issuers to run compliant raises on our platform or embed CoinList's deal flow into their own products via APIs and SDKs The Consumer Marketplace (coinlist.co): The world's leading destination to invest in token sales, pre-IPO stocks, tokenized equities, and on-chain funds. Through its token sale platform, CoinList has launched many of the leading crypto protocols including Solana, Near, USD.AI, and Ondo. About This Role We have a strong engineering team with deep expertise in infrastructure, blockchain, and specialized domains. We are looking for a smart contract engineer who can build smart contracts to integrate with different asset providers (Ondo, Centrifuge, etc.). Those smart contracts act as a proxy between our users and the underlying assets. They offer a common interface so we can build similar products on top of them. You'd be joining a small engineering team and directly reporting to the CTO in a greenfield-heavy environment where your work directly affects velocity, company direction, and revenue. What You'll Do You'll ship contracts to mainnet. We are investing in Solidity on EVM chains. This is where most of your work will live, reviewed by external auditors, deployed, and holding user funds. We move fast while keeping the technical bar as high as possible You'll design contract systems, not just functions. As a senior engineer, we expect you to design systems from the ground up, including boundaries, interfaces, storage layout, upgrade strategy, access control, and emergency paths. You'll also help decide what even belongs onchain at all You'll be an owner. As part of a small team, everyone owns meaningful work, whether it's the contracts behind a critical token sale or leading our onchain work on a new product You'll treat security as the job. Adversarial review of your colleagues' contracts and of external audit findings, fuzzing and invariant tests, deployment rehearsals on testnets, and monitoring and incident response are all expected You'll rapidly grow and improve. You'll be working with incredibly smart engineers who love to learn and teach each other. And if you want to extend your craft to Rust and the Solana runtime, we'll invest in that with you Requirements What We're Looking For You bring over 7 years of professional working experience, including at least 2 years of writing Solidity that reached production You know the EVM from the inside. Storage layout and packing, gas mechanics, memory versus calldata versus storage, ABI encoding, events and indexing, contract size limits, and the tradeoffs hiding inside each one You know the modern Solidity patterns. Proxies and upgradeability, role-based access control, signature verification and replay protection (EIP-712), reentrancy and oracle or price-manipulation defenses You have real tooling and testing discipline. Foundry (preferred) or Hardhat, fork tests, fuzzing and invariants, and a testing workflow you can justify from first principles rather than because it's what the tutorial did You think like an attacker before you ship. You ask what a flash loan, an MEV bot, or a malicious token does to your code, and you write down what you find You like to ship high-quality code. You make deadlines for yourself, and you move fast. You focus on the things that matter and push back on things that don't. People know they can count on you to get things done How You Work You're AI-fluent.
